text: nandanasuttaṃ [258] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho nandano devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi pucchāmi taṃ gotama bhūripañña anāvaṭaṃ bhagavato ñāṇadassanaṃ #1 po. yu. maccuvasaṅgā . 2 sī. bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi . 3 ma. ce. . yu. ca. . kathaṃvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti kathaṃvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti kathaṃvidho 1 dukkhamaticca iriyati kathaṃvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti . [259] yo sīlavā paññavā bhāvitatto samāhito jhānarato 2 satīmā sabbassa sokā vigatā pahīnā khīṇāsavo antimadehadhārī tathāvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti tathāvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti tathāvidho dukkhamaticca iriyati tathāvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti . pañcamaṃ
